# Fixture: decision-benefit juxtaposition pattern (bad)

In November, the board decided to authorize the asset transfer. The directors moved to approve it without further review.

By December, Cole Industries had acquired the parcels for a fraction of the assessed value. The same directors profited from the sale to the secondary buyer the following spring.
